title: EU Approves $110 Billion Paramount-Warner Bros Merger as US Review Continues
author: Michael Chen
image: /images/news/EU Approves $110 Billion Paramount-Warner Bros Merger as US Review Continues.webp
excerpt: The European Commission has approved the proposed $110 billion merger between Paramount Global and Warner Bros. Discovery, though the landmark media deal remains under regulatory review in the United States.

title: Nike Tightens China Online Sales Strategy as Sportswear Giant Battles Declining Demand and Local Rivals
author: Emily Rodriguez
image: /images/news/Nike Tightens China Online Sales Strategy as Sportswear Giant Battles Declining Demand and Local Rivals.webp
excerpt: Nike is restructuring its China online sales strategy by cutting third-party distributors and focusing on official digital channels as the company attempts to recover market share amid weaker demand and rising competition.

title: Paramount Delays Warner Bros. Discovery Deal as Antitrust Battle Moves to Court
author: Sarah Jenkins
image: /images/news/Paramount Delays Warner Bros. Discovery Deal as Antitrust Battle Moves to Court.webp
excerpt: Paramount Skydance has delayed its Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition as U.S. states challenge the $110 billion merger over competition concerns.

title: Shell Profits Double as Oil Prices Surge Amid Iran War
author: Business Desk
image: /images/news/Shell Profits Double as Oil Prices Surge Amid Iran War.webp
excerpt: Shell more than doubled its second-quarter profit to $9.84 billion as higher oil and gas prices driven by the Iran conflict boosted trading and refining earnings, allowing the energy giant to maintain its shareholder returns.

title: Apollo Launches £5.7 Billion Takeover Offer for easyJet, Outbidding Rivals
author: Jessica Wu
image: /images/news/Global Markets Slide as Oil Surges on Escalating Gulf Conflict.webp
excerpt: Apollo Global Management has made a surprise £5.7 billion takeover bid for easyJet, offering a higher price than rival bidder Castlelake and potentially reshaping Europe's airline industry.

title: A Gift of Movement: Britannia Financial Group, Serpentine and the Public Legacy of Jesús Rafael Soto
author: Business Desk
excerpt: Britannia Financial Group supports Jesús Rafael Soto's Pénétrable BBL Jaune at Serpentine South, bringing a landmark work of kinetic art into Kensington Gardens.

title: Tesla China Business Sale Report Raises Questions Over Potential SpaceX Merger With Musk
author: Business Desk
image: /images/news/Tesla Considers China Business Separation as Elon Musk’s SpaceX Merger Plans Spark Debate.webp
excerpt: Tesla is reportedly considering separating its China operations ahead of a possible SpaceX merger, but Elon Musk has dismissed the reports as false.

title: UFC Freedom 250 White House Event Lost $30 Million as TKO Reveals High Production Costs
author: Tech Desk

excerpt: UFC’s Freedom 250 event at the White House generated global attention but resulted in a $30 million loss, according to parent company TKO Group Holdings.
